description: A Svelte logo cloud built from the SvGrid UI kit: a heading and one line of social proof over a grid of twelve made-up customer wordmarks, each an inline SVG glyph with its own type style. Wordmarks with a case study are links that go from muted to full contrast on hover or keyboard focus, and an SvButton under the grid opens all customer stories.

faq.question: Which logos are links?
faq.answer: Each logo in createLogoCloud({ logos }) has an optional href. Logos with one render as an <a> spread with linkProps(), which sets the href and an aria-label like "Northwind customer story"; logos without one render as a plain labelled element that stays muted on hover.

faq.question: Can I route the links myself?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass onOpen and linkProps() prevents the default navigation and calls it with the logo, which the demo uses to show a toast. Leave onOpen out and the links navigate to their href like normal anchors.

faq.question: How does the grid wrap on phones?
faq.answer: Four columns on desktop, three below 860 px and two below 480 px, where the wordmarks shrink a little. Each cell draws its own right and bottom rule and the frame clips the outer ones, so a list that does not fill the last row still looks clean.
